items.title: Stage-H STRICT goal isolation: does silencing the E3 goal term change LEARNED avoidance?
items.note: DIAGNOSTIC (experiment_purpose=diagnostic, claim_ids=[] DELIBERATELY -- a null must not silently re-weight SD-054/MECH-295/307; route interpretation through governance). Measures the DV the 2026-07-27 scaffold goal-freeze triage explicitly left unmeasured: the triage showed the E3 goal term fires on 100% of Stage-H ticks with 0.65x the harm term's candidate spread and a 38% argmin-flip rate, but that is a SELECTION counterfactual, not a DV. 2 arms x 20 seeds, paired WITHIN seed, differing ONLY in ScaffoldedSD054OnboardingConfig.scaffold_strict_goal_isolation (landed ree-v3 bd66d67f77, default False). Both arms build config from experiments/_lib/baselines/stageh_strict_goal_isolation.py so the single-variable claim holds by construction. CONFIG ANCHOR: V3-EXQ-603q ARM_BASE_IA_ONLY, truncated after Stage-H (P1/P2 dropped -- they run after the frozen stages and cannot inform a Stage-H DV). stage0_enabled + hazard_stage_enabled + feed_harm_stream + train_harm_pathway all ON: without z_goal formation the goal term is inert and the comparison vacuous (the triage's five inert exceptions), and without harm-pathway training the harm cost is a random constant (603i) so survival is unreachable at any budget. SEEDS=20 NOT the family-standard 3, and this is the load-bearing design decision: decomposing 603q's Stage-H episode lengths gives 93% of variance BETWEEN seeds (29.3 vs 8.1 within), so episodes/seed is not a precision lever and seeds are; and 603q's own within-seed arm delta had SD 51.4 against a mean of 23.3, so at n=3 SE_delta ~30 on a ~38-step baseline -- unfalsifiable either way. At n=20, 2*SE ~23.0 steps, under the pre-registered 25-step ceiling, and ~= the measured effect of the FULL escape-affordance bridge, so a null rules out a goal-term effect as large as an entire validated mechanism. Holds while SD_delta<=55.9 (9% margin over 603q). PRE-REGISTERED BOTH DIRECTIONS: outcome PASS = an ANSWER was reached, of either kind -- effect detected (|mean_delta| >= max(2*SE, 5.0 steps)) OR an adequately-powered null (2*SE <= 25.0). The null is recorded as PASS deliberately so it reads as the informative outcome that DISCHARGES the isolation worry, not as a failed run. FAIL only when no answer was reachable: substrate_not_ready_requeue (a readiness precondition unmet) or underpowered_null_more_seeds_required -- NEVER a substrate verdict. Regime-conditioned readiness gate (experiments/_lib/precondition_gate.py, applies_to): goal_term_live_in_stageh applies to ARM_LEGACY only, strict_isolation_applied to ARM_STRICT only -- asserting either on the other arm would make it structurally un-passable (the V3-EXQ-785 lesson). Top-level non_degenerate additionally requires BOTH arms green because the estimand is PAIRED (a green STRICT with a red LEGACY answers nothing); this is a tightening for a paired design, not the 785 defect, since there is no independent per-arm finding to vacate. DV-SYMMETRY: DV = mean Stage-H episode length, invariant under order-preserving changes to the E3 cost (broadcast constant / monotone rescaling). The manipulation is NOT invariant: goal_proximity is PER-CANDIDATE, and the triage measured spread 0.1022 and a 38% argmin flip where a broadcast constant would give exactly 0 and 0. Neither arm is structurally vacuous. GOV-REUSE-1: decisive readout is the paired strict-ON-vs-OFF Stage-H survival delta; NO landed manifest carries a strict-ON arm (the knob landed 2026-07-27 default-False and all 78 scaffold importers ran the legacy path -- verified by grep across experiments/ and evidence/experiments/), so it is unrecoverable by reanalysis and must be run. MINT-AS-YOU-GO: cells emitted reuse-eligible with include_driver_script_in_hash=False so a successor's different driver can reuse them. REPRODUCIBILITY: comparison is within-seed AND within-process -- the scaffold curriculum is not reproducible across processes; confirmed again in this session's two smokes (seed 42 ARM_LEGACY Stage-H mean 11.8 then 13.4). NOTE a concurrent session has an UNCOMMITTED scaffold edit adding scaffold_env_layout_seed (unseeded CausalGridWorld construction is the residual entropy source); once landed it would let both arms share an env layout per seed and cut the arm x seed interaction that drives this experiment's seed count -- a worthwhile successor, not depended on here. Smoke PASS (self-routes substrate_not_ready_requeue on dry budgets, as designed; manipulation verified biting: LEGACY goal_weight=1.000/e1_gc=True/goal_live=True vs STRICT 0.000/False/False).

items.title: MECH-294 behavioural falsifier: joint/alt/shuffled theta binding, per-candidate coherence routed via route-range authority, committed-action TV
items.note: MECH-294 behavioural-evidence successor (experiment_purpose=evidence; weights confidence). Unblocked by route-range readiness V3-EXQ-790 (both science criteria PASS; false substrate_not_ready_requeue withdrawn as a gate defect per failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-790_2026-07-22, user-adjudicated) + V3-EXQ-791a PASS (label route_range_substrate_ready, ree-cloud-2). GOV-REUSE-1: decisive readout = committed-action-class TV across joint/alt/shuffled binding WITH per-candidate coherence routed; NOT recorded (V3-EXQ-661 measured TV~0 with SCALAR coherence, pre the 2026-06-19 per-candidate amend), checked 657/657a/661 -> run. Re-derive brake count=1 (<2) -> not braked. Routes per-candidate co-binding coherence via modulatory_channel_route_source=coherence through the route-range selection authority. C1 (JOINT!=ALTERNATION) + C2 (JOINT!=SHUFFLED) are the load-bearing joint-clause criteria (design memo S6/S7.3). Same-statistic readiness gate asserts route_range (a cross-candidate RANGE -- the stat the authority carves and C1/C2 route on downstream), so a committed-TV null is a claim result ONLY when the manipulation is a supra-floor range, never the 661 rescale-invisible scalar. DV-symmetry (per arm): JOINT/ALT per-candidate coherence is a supra-floor/distinct cross-candidate range (NOT a broadcast scalar -> not invariant under the argmax symmetry of the committed-class DV); SHUFFLED ~0 (inert structural control, carries no route-range gate, scored only on committed-window sample + candidate diversity). Smoke 2026-07-29 mode-distinct as designed: route_range JOINT 0.068 / ALT 0.057 / SHUF 0.0 / OFF 0.0; smoke PASS, no crash, all 4 arms build+route. goal_latent packet slot is benefit-gated (benefit_exposure=0.0 per the proven 649/791a harness), so co-binding is tested over the current streams; z_goal_stream_stats recorded for review. Queued under --allow-overlap vs gracious-snyder SD-084/V3-EXQ-839 (different task, shared experiment_queue.json append target -- not duplicated work).

items.title: MECH-313 committed-path authority dissociation (687 successor, DIAGNOSTIC)
items.note: DIAGNOSTIC (excluded from confidence/conflict scoring). Successor to V3-EXQ-687 per failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-687_2026-06-18 (arms the 569i-validated GAP-A conversion stack constant on all arms + adds a MECH-260 operativity precondition), RE-SCOPED from evidence to diagnostic. WHY RE-SCOPED: a static line-pin at authoring time shows MECH-313 is a UNIFORM softmax-temperature lift (agent.py:7261) entering E3 at one site (e3_selector.py:3101), while the committed branch is a hard argmin over _modulatory_accum (e3_selector.py:3380) under the default use_gap_scaled_commit_temperature=False. A uniform temperature is a monotone rescaling, so it cannot move an argmin: on a committed-action DV ARM_1==ARM_0 and ARM_3==ARM_2 ARITHMETICALLY and the Q-045 interaction cell is unmeasurable. So this probe measures WHETHER the tonic channel reaches committed selection (emitting precommit vs committed entropy + the committed fraction) instead of assuming it does. use_gap_scaled_commit_temperature is left FALSE deliberately -- flipping it would test 'MECH-313 GIVEN MECH-439'. DV-SYMMETRY (required declaration): ARM_1/ARM_3 committed_action_entropy IS invariant under the manipulation -- that is the hypothesis under test, measured not assumed; precommit_entropy is NOT invariant (softmax is temperature-scaled) and is the positive control. ARM_2/ARM_3 dACC suppression is a PER-CANDIDATE additive penalty (dacc.py:401), not a broadcast scalar, so it is not invariant under argmin. ARM_0 no manipulation. INSTRUMENT REPAIR: V3-EXQ-687 read the dACC bundle as dacc._last_bundle, which does not exist (it is agent._dacc_last_bundle, agent.py:6148), so its dacc_max_suppression was pinned to 0.0 BY CONSTRUCTION -- an artifact, not a measurement, and the 687 autopsy section 6.2 record/score-decoupling root cause rests on it. Repaired here; the smoke now reads suppression 1.0 on both dACC arms. RE-DERIVE BRAKE: fires at 5/8/13 autopsies (Q-045/MECH-313/MECH-260) vs threshold 2; RELEASED because the named upstream substrate (GAP-A conversion stack) is built and VALIDATED by V3-EXQ-569i PASS/supports, and the 687 autopsy records recommended_substrate_queue_entry.action=none. GOV-REUSE-1: decisive readout is committed-vs-precommit action entropy under a fresh-selection gate; checked 687 and 603e manifests -- neither records a fresh-select-gated or precommit entropy at all (687 emitted only the hold-weighted selected_action_entropy), so not recoverable -> run. Carries the five 603e-autopsy instrument repairs: fresh-selection gating via _lib/fresh_select (sentinel key, NOT the = None idiom -- agent.py:9660 reads the dict on non-E3 ticks), both readouts kept distinct, pre-registered margin plus a cross-seed-SD gate (603e's C3 landed true on 0.001235 nats), behavioural-coverage conjunct, and FIFO warmup expressed in FRESH SELECTIONS. Smoke PASS; validate_experiments --strict OK with 0 warnings.

items.title: SD-084 validation: is MECH-321's R4 MID-EXECUTION decomposition hook reachable under a standard driver loop?
items.note: DIAGNOSTIC (experiment_purpose=diagnostic, claim_ids=[] DELIBERATELY -- this VALIDATES A SUBSTRATE BUILD and must not weight MECH-321/ARC-070/ARC-071/MECH-288; bears_on records them). Validates SD-084 REEConfig.use_persistent_committed_program_handle (landed 2026-07-29, ree-v3 a21f487709 / REE_assembly 72c86d5e4e). ACCEPTANCE CRITERION verbatim from failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-830_2026-07-29.md recommended_substrate_queue_entry.failure_record_entry.target: 'decomp_n_evaluated_midexec > 0 on a standard select_action -> update_residue driver loop, without hand-injected preconditions'. That is C1, the ONLY load-bearing criterion. WHY IT MATTERS: MECH-321's R4 mid-execution phase has NEVER EXECUTED in any experiment and could not -- E3Selector.post_action_update's last statement unconditionally destroys _committed_trajectory while the hook (agent.py select_action gate 4) needs it to survive ACROSS ticks. V3-EXQ-830 measured decomp_n_evaluated_midexec = 0 in all 10 cells against decomp_n_evaluated_precommit 1862-2618. ARMS: 2 x 6 seeds, paired within seed, differing ONLY in use_persistent_committed_program_handle. Both arms built from experiments/_lib/baselines/sd084_midexec_reachability.py so the single-variable claim holds by construction. Config anchored on tests/contracts/test_mech321_midexec_natural_reachability.py -- the minimal configuration in which the hook has actually been observed to fire (default CausalGridWorldV2, decomposition_vs_threshold=0.99, decomposition_depth_cap=3, one crystallised 3-action ARC-071 chunk registered in BOTH arms). GOV-REUSE-1: NOT recoverable from existing manifests -- the decisive readout is midexec>0 WITH the SD-084 flag on, and no manifest can carry it (the flag landed 2026-07-29 and zero drivers referenced it; every prior substrate_hash predates the landing). Checked V3-EXQ-830 (the structural zero) and grepped experiments/ + git log -S. Run required. TWO PRE-REGISTERED SEED TIERS, both MEASURED not guessed (--seed-scan over 10 candidates, darwin-arm64, seeded env, 2ep x 60 steps): ATTRIBUTABLE (3,47,71,89) commit multi-action programs and fire the hook when ON (14-29 midexec evaluations); NEGATIVE CONTROL (23,53) commit NONE with pre-commit decomposition still live (146/202 per cell), so the DV must be 0 in BOTH arms and the arms must be bit-identical. OFF fired ZERO on all ten seeds, including seed 47 which commits 30 multi-action programs -- the teardown admits no exceptions. The control tier is why the run DEMONSTRATES attributability rather than asserting it. SEED-DEPENDENCE IS THE DESIGN RISK AND IS INSTRUMENTED: gate (6) is len(remaining)>1, so the hook only fires after a MULTI-ACTION commit, and E3 commits a multi-action chunk only when it beats the CEM-optimised candidates on raw score -- there is NO chunk-selection-bias knob. multi_action_commits is recorded PER CELL as a readiness precondition, so a zero DV can never be confused between 'SD-084 failed' and 'this seed never committed a multi-action program'; the latter self-routes substrate_not_ready_requeue, never a substrate verdict. The gate is EXISTENTIAL PER ARM (max, not worst-cell): a worst-cell gate would be failed by the negative-control tier by construction and would vacate the four attributable seeds -- the V3-EXQ-785 red-arm-vacates-green failure one level down. ENV SEEDING -- A REAL DEFECT FOUND AND FIXED DURING AUTHORING. The contract builds CausalGridWorldV2() UNSEEDED, which is fine for its existential assertions but NOT for a paired experiment: reset_all_rng(seed) does not make an unseeded env reproducible. Measured by running the OFF arm TWICE at one seed (pure replicate): 3-11 of 24 actions differed and precommit counts differed 40 vs 84. With seed= passed to the env the same replicate gives 0/24 and identical counts. Without this the paired behavioural delta would have measured RNG noise, and the arm-reuse fingerprint would have been a lie (an eligible cell promises to be a pure function of substrate+config+seed). Env is now seeded per cell; env_seeded_per_cell is declared in the fingerprint config slice. MACHINE-CLASS CAVEAT: the seed table is darwin-arm64. torch.multinomial is not cross-class reproducible and E3 samples that way in the live selection path, so seeding buys determinism WITHIN a class, not across. A full cloud confirmation scan could not complete -- all four fleet boxes were saturated with other sessions' work and it was stopped to free capacity -- but ONE cell landed and matched EXACTLY: seed 3 ARM_HANDLE_OFF on linux-x86_64-py3.10-torch2.12.0+cpu gave multi=12 total=27 midexec=0 precommit=130, identical in all four fields to the darwin row, suggesting the commit decision here is driven by the deterministic chunk-vs-CEM score comparison rather than a multinomial draw. One cell of twelve, so encouraging not conclusive. The readiness gate is the backstop and --seed-scan re-measures the pool in minutes on whichever box claims it. DV-SYMMETRY (failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-604c section 3), declared per arm: primary DV decomp_n_evaluated_midexec is a COUNT over ticks, whose symmetry group is permutations of the tick index set. The manipulation is NOT invariant -- it changes each tick's indicator itself by deciding whether gate (4) passes, and is neither a broadcast additive constant (which would cancel in an argmax and in a max-minus-min range) nor a monotone rescaling. Secondary behavioural DVs derive from the argmax action sequence; the manipulation acts by RELEASING THE COMMIT LATCH -- a change of BRANCH in select_action, not an offset on candidate scores -- so it is not invariant there either. BEHAVIOURAL PAYLOAD IS RECORDED BUT NOT ADJUDICATED. SD-084 ON is not a pure diagnostic: a mid-execution fire reaches boundary.fired (MECH-321 R1's OR trigger) and RELEASES THE COMMIT LATCH, aborting the remaining macro, so action sequences change. behavioural_delta records per-seed action-sequence divergence, first-divergence tick, committed-run length, beta-elevated fraction and harm -- both hold-weighted and hold-unweighted -- for a successor evidence experiment to consume rather than re-derive. This run adjudicates REACHABILITY only (C1); C4 asserts merely that the arms differ at all, on the attributable tier, which is the SD doc's own stated property. NO PHASED TRAINING: no head is trained on z_world/z_harm/any encoder output -- counters are read off PolicyDecomposition.get_state() during the ordinary online loop, so there is no moving latent target. z_goal is deliberately inert (from_dims defaults z_goal_enabled=False so GoalState is never constructed); the counters are recorded so that is visible rather than unmeasured. SMOKE: --dry-run PASS on the final 6-seed 2-tier config -- midexec ON=9 OFF=0, negative control expectation_held=True and divergence=0.0, both arms green, all four criteria pass, validate_experiments --strict clean with zero advisories (the hold-weighted-readout advisory was TRIAGED and fixed -- n_fresh_select/n_latched/fresh_select_yield emitted -- not exempted). MINT: ARM_HANDLE_OFF cells emit reuse-ELIGIBLE with include_driver_script_in_hash=False from the canonical baseline module, so a later different-driver successor matches by construction.
